metadata.description: Sample Agent Skills and plugins you can install and try, each built around a fictional company so nothing exposes real data

plugins.name: rfp-response
plugins.description: Turns an incoming RFP into a submission-ready proposal — matches the request to a product offering, answers from a library of pre-approved answers, flags what it can't answer, and produces Markdown plus a formatted PDF.

plugins.name: build-work-estimator
plugins.description: Estimates the work of BUILDING something with an AI coding agent -- turns, tokens, and cost -- calibrated from your own session history, with a required contingency reserve, build-time Copilot Credits for Microsoft work, and Markdown plus PDF reports. Estimates the build, never the run.
